śivarahasye || pādatīrthaprasādābhyāṃ kuryālliṃgārcanaṃ sadā || yaḥ seveta sa bhaktānāṃ mama rūpaṃ tu pārvati || 145 || pārameśvarāgame || pādābhiṣekasalilaṃ liṃgamajjanamuttamam || matprasādaṃ ca naivedyaṃ tathā muktiphalaṃ dhruvam || 146 || brahmāṇḍapurāṇe || jaṃgamānāṃ ca caraṇasalilaṃ pāpanāśanam || prasādaṃ mokṣasiddhyarthaṃ satyamīśvarabhāṣitam || 147 || jaṃgamasya pādatīrthaṃ liṃgamajjanamuttamam || tatprasādaṃ mahādevi naivedyaṃ śubhamaṃgalam || 148 || īśvara uvāca || tasmājjaṃgamaliṃgasya prasādena mamārpayet || abhiṣekajalasnānaṃ viśeṣaṃ mama kathyate || 149 || carapādodakaṃ liṃge snānaṃ prasādamarpayet || pracārānubhavaśceti so'pi bhaktaśca kathyate || 150 || jaṃgamo jñānarūpaśca kriyārūpaṃ ca liṃgakam || tadaṃghrijalasnānaṃ ca śeṣaṃ samarpaṇaṃ bhavet || 151 || tasmājjaṃgamaliṃgasya prasādaḥ sevito mayā || pajjalenaiva snānaṃ hi kartavyaṃ śikhivāhana || 152 || liṃgabhaktāśrayaṃ vatsa śṛṇuṣvaikamanāssadā || carapādodakaṃ liṃge snāpya prasādamarpayet || 153 ||
naṃdikeśvara uvāca || pādodakaṃ prasādānnaṃ nityamāsevināṃ nṛṇām || daśapāpavināśastu kathyate gaṇapuṃgava || 154 || matprāṇo jaṃgamo devi malliṃgaṃ jaṃgamastathā || āvayostatprasādastu bhogyaḥ syāditi niścinu || 155 || vīrāgame || svayaṃ prasādarūpo'yaṃ saccijjaṃgama ucyate || saukhyaṃ śataguṇādhikyaṃ prasādātprāpyate nṛṇām || 156 || śākaṭāyane || śiṣyaprāṇo gururdevi guruprāṇastu jaṃgamaḥ || jaṃgamasya prasādaḥ syātsarvaśāstreṣu gīyate || 157 ||
vīraśaivācārapradīpikāyāṃ gurulakṣaṇam devyuvāca(-) kaleḥ kaluṣite kāle durjaye duratikramaṃ || kṣīṇe varṇāśramācāre saṃkare samupāgate || 1 || kenopāyena mucyaṃte bhaktāstava maheśvara || 2 || īśvara uvāca || saṃsāraduḥkhakāṃtāre nimagnaśca mahātape || cakravadbhramate devi liṃgārcanavivarjitaḥ || 3 || yo jātu nārcayelliṃgaṃ na smarenna ca kīrtayet || kiṃ tena jātamātreṇa bhūbhāreṇānnaśatruṇā || 4 ||
apūjayitvā ceśānaṃ yo hi bhuṃkte narādhamaḥ || pāpānāmannarūpāṇāṃ tasya bhojanamucyate || 5 || nāsti liṃgārcanaṃ yasya mleṃchayonau prajāyate || na śivārcanasāmyo'sti dharmo'nyo bhuvanatraye || 6 || iti jñātvā prayatnena pūjanīyaḥ sadāśivaḥ || satyaṃ vacmi hitaṃ vacmi sāraṃ vacmi punaḥ punaḥ || 7 || liṃgamadhye mahādevaḥ sākṣāddevo vyavasthitaḥ || anugrahāya lokānāṃ tasmālliṃgaṃ prapūjayet || 8 || upadeśaṃ vinā liṃgaṃ prapūjayati yo naraḥ || narake pacyate devi sūpadeśo hyataḥ smṛtaḥ || 9 || yathā mṛgapatiṃ dṛṣṭvā bhavedbhīto vane gajaḥ || adīkṣito'rcayelliṃgaṃ tathā bhīto maheśvaraḥ || 10 || tripuṃḍraṃ caiva rudrākṣaṃ nityārcanajapastathā || homadhyānādikaṃ sarvaṃ dīkṣāhīnasya niṣphalaṃ || 11 || adīkṣitaścaturvedī na viśedgarbhagehakaṃ || pramādādgarbhagehaṃ tu prāyaścittaṃ tu kārayet || 12 || adīkṣitaśca yo vipraḥ kuryālliṃgasya pūjanaṃ || araṇye nirjane devi bhavati brahmarākṣasaḥ || 13 || caturvedī tvahaṃkārī śivaliṃgaṃ tu pūjayet || rājarāṣṭravināśaśca tasya grāmo'pi naśyati || 14 || dīyate jñānasaṃbaṃdhaḥ kṣīyate ca malatrayam || dīyate kṣīyate yena sā dīkṣati nigadyate || 15 || upadeśaṃ caupadiśa vīraśaivīyadīkṣayā ||
guruṃ vicārayecchiṣyo mahādevaṃ prapūjayet || 16 || vṛttaṃ || nityānityavicāravāniha paratrāpekṣitārthāratiḥ śāṃtyādyaṃgasamanvitaḥ sucarito mokṣābhilāṣī sukhī || satyānaṃdaparaṃ prakāśaparipūrṇātmāvabodhānvitaṃ kṛtyākṛtyavivekinaṃ guruvaraṃ preyānnaro bhaktimān || 17 || sadvaṃśajaḥ samāpūrṇaḥ praśāṃtaḥ priyabhāṣaṇaḥ || gaṃbhīraḥ satyavāgvāgmī saṃtuṣṭaḥ karuṇāspadaḥ || 18 || snigdhaḥ smitamukho rāgī pragalbho nirahaṃkṛtiḥ || śuciḥ suśīlo dharmiṣṭhaḥ sadākṣiṇyo bṛhaddhvaniḥ || 19 || nirmatsaro guṇagrāhī praśāṃto vijiteṃdriyaḥ || vedāṃgeṣu kṛtābhyāsaḥ purāṇaśrutivittamaḥ || 20 || sarvāgameṣu kuśalaḥ kulīnaśca mahāmatiḥ || maṃtroddhārapravīṇaśca maṃtrārthapratipādakaḥ || 21 || (suprabodhāgame) padavākyapramāṇajño vedavedāṃtapāragaḥ || tithinakṣatrayogajño bhūparigrahakarmavit || 22 || śaivasiddhāṃtatatvajñaḥ pratiṣṭhāmaṃtrapāragaḥ || mokṣadaḥ karuṇopeto vītarāgo vimatsaraḥ || 23 || kriyāpāde tu nipuṇaścaryāpāde tu raṃjakaḥ || yogapāde kṛtābhyāso jñānapāde viśeṣavit || 24 || kriyādijñānaparyaṃtaṃ śivatatvaviniścayaḥ ||
saṃpradāyāgatajñāno lobhadaṃbhavivarjitaḥ || 25 || liṃgāṃgasthalabhedajñaḥ ṣaṭsthalajñānatatparaḥ || śivasiddhāṃtatatvajñaḥ ṣaḍadhvajñānavatsalaḥ || 26 || nityakarmādikuśalo namittikavicakṣaṇaḥ || kāmyādikarmacaturo dīkṣākarmādikarmaṭhaḥ || 27 || maṃḍale maṃḍape kuṃḍe prāsāde pratimāsu ca || liṃgapīṭhe śilāyāṃ ca parīkṣānipuṇāgraṇīḥ || 28 || śivasya ca gurorbhaktaḥ śivaikāhitamānasaḥ || śivārcanāsaktacittaḥ śivadhyānaikatatparaḥ || 29 || gukāraṃ ca guṇātītaṃ rukāraṃ rūpavarjitaṃ || guṇātītamarūpaṃ ca yo dadyātsa guruḥ smṛtaḥ || 30 || nirākāraṃ nirālaṃbaṃ nirmalaṃ nirvikalpakaṃ || nirguṇaṃ niṣkalaṃ nityaṃ parātparapadaṃ guruṃ || 31 || (vīrāgame) lalāṭalocanaṃ cāṃdrīṃ kalāmapi ca dordvayaṃ || aṃtarnidhāya varte'haṃ gururūpo maheśvari || 32 || vasate pādayugme tu trailokyaṃ sacarācaram || aṃguṣṭhāgre cāṣṭaṣaṣṭhitīrthānyasminvasaṃti vai || 33 || saptābdhayastu pādādhastadūrdhvaṃ cāṣṭa te nagāḥ || jaṃghayorvasate nityaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśattatvasaṃcayaḥ || 34 ||
smartavyaḥ paṭhanīyaśca guruḥ paramakāraṇaḥ || gurudevaṃ mahādevaṃ caikabhāvena bhāvitāḥ || 35 || triṣu lokeṣu pūjyaṃte te narā gurubhaktitaḥ || gururgṛhastha eva syānna kadācidyatirguruḥ || 36 || yathāhaṃ sarvalokānāṃ gururaṃbikayā saha || 37 || (kriyāsāre) īśvara uvāca || gṛhasthaḥ sarvavarṇeṣu śreṣṭho gururudāhṛtaḥ || naiṣṭhikastvadhamo jñeyo bhāṃtikastu tato'dhamaḥ || 38 || vānaprasthayatīnāṃ tu gurutvaṃ niṣphalaṃ sadā || śiṣyasya śikṣaṇīyatvādgururgauravabhāvataḥ || 39 || tasmātsarvaprayatnena gururgauravamācaret || vayaḥ ṣoḍaśakādūrdhvamiṣyate saptateradhaḥ || 40 || śivajñānāmṛtasvādaparisaṃtuṣṭamānasaḥ || tatvavicchivasaṃyukto muktido na tu cāparaḥ || 41 || guravo bahavaḥ saṃti śiṣyavittāpahārakāḥ || durlabho'yaṃ gururdevi śiṣyahṛttāpahārakaḥ || 42 || (siddhāṃtaśikhāmaṇau) jñānahīnaṃ guruṃ prāpya kuto muktimavāpnuyāt || bhinnanaukāgataḥ (bhinnanāvaṃ gataḥ) siṃdhoryathā pāraṃ na gacchati || 43 || tasmājjñānādhikaṃ śiṣyo gurumeva samāśrayet || itthaṃ guruḥ samākhyāto varjanīyo'dhunocyate || 44 ||
vyasanī vāmanaḥ kubjaḥ kopī ca kulaṭaḥ śaṭhaḥ || capalo'dhikahīnāṃgaḥ pāpīyānsūcako'nyajaḥ || 45 || vyādhigastārkikaḥ śūraḥ kākanādo bakavratī || gurudevadvijātīnāṃ niṃdako vṛṣalīpatiḥ || 46 || apūjyakulasaṃbhūtastrīkarmī śivavarjitaḥ (sevyavarjitaḥ)|| laṃboṣṭho vakranāsaśca gavīnaḥ kalahapriyaḥ || 47 || parāpavādaśīlaśca paragraṃthopajīvakaḥ || bālā bahuguṇairyuktā vṛddhāḥ khaṃjāstathaiva ca || 48 || evamādiguṇairyuktā varjanīyāḥ prayatnataḥ || pūrvaṃ guruṃ parityajya yo'nyaṃ gurumupāśrayet || 49 || sa punarbhūriti jñeyaḥ sarvakarmasu garhitaḥ || dvijātirvā tataḥ śūdraḥ svasvoktācāravān śuciḥ || 50 || satyavāggurubhaktaśca daṃbhāhaṃkāravarjitaḥ || rāgadveṣavinirmuktaḥ śāṃtaḥ sarvajanapriyaḥ || 51 || ahiṃsako dayāvāṃśca nityamudyuktacetanaḥ (nityavidhyuktacetanaḥ)|| guruśuśrūṣaṇarato manovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || 52 || bahiraṃtaścaraiḥ prāṇairgurubhaktiyuto naraḥ || gururevaṃvidhaṃ śiṣyaṃ varṣamekaṃ parīkṣayet || 53 || gurvājñācakitaḥ saumyaḥ śiṣya ityabhidhīyate ||
jñānena kriyayā cātha guruḥ śiṣyaṃ viśodhayet || 54 || yo'nyathā kurute mohātsa vinaśyati durmatiḥ || tasmātsarvaprayatnena guruḥ śiṣyaṃ parīkṣayet || 55 || bhaktiśca śivabhakteṣu śraddhā tacchāsanāvidhau || dehapātastathā kaṃpaḥ paramānaṃdaharṣaṇe || svedo romāṃca ityetacchaktipātasya lakṣaṇaṃ || 56 || (iti śaktipātalakṣaṇam) uktalakṣaṇasaṃpanno yasmin deśe guruḥ sthitaḥ || tatra śiṣyaḥ svayaṃ gatvā praṇameddaṃḍavadguruṃ || 57 || svaguruṃ vā maheśaṃ vā praṇamedekapāṇinā || yadi pūrvārjitaṃ puṇyaṃ tatsarvaṃ ca vinaśyati || 58 || aṣṭāṃgairatha paṃcāṃgaistribhiraṃgairnamastridhā || urasā śirasā dṛṣṭyā manasā śraddhayā girā || 59 || padbhyāṃ karābhyāṃ jānubhyāṃ praṇāmo'ṣṭāṃga ucyate || śiraḥ karābhyāṃ jānubhyāṃ paṃcāṃgaiḥ praṇamecchivaṃ || 60 || brahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca īśvaraśca sadāśivaḥ || ete garbhagatā yasya tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 61 || ajñānatimirāṃdhasya jñānāṃjanaśalākayā || cakṣurunmīlitaṃ yena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 62 || anaṃtajanmasaṃprāptakarmedhanavidāhine || jñānānalaprabhāvena tasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 63 || bhavāraṇyapraviṣṭasya diṅmohabhrāṃtacetasaḥ || yena me darśitaḥ paṃthāstasmai śrīgurave namaḥ || 64 ||
deśikasya mukhaṃ dṛṣṭvā praṇameddaṃḍavadbhuvi || pataṃti sarvapāpāni nottiṣṭhaṃti punaḥ saha || 65 || guruṃ didṛkṣuryaḥ śiṣyaḥ sadbhaktyā'nudinaṃ sa tu || riktapāṇirna taṃ paśyedyathā rājā tathā guruḥ || 66 || svāmin bhaṭṭārakācārya mayyevaṃ tvaṃ kṛpāṃ kuru || ityuktaṃ pravadecchiṣyamupadeśaṃ karomyaham || 67 || anugrahakaraṇārthe jape viniyogaḥ niṣkalo devatā sujñāna ṛṣiḥ || anuṣṭup chaṃdaḥ nādarūpe praṇavaṃ bījam || mūlamaṃtreṇa paṃcatatvānāṃ sādākhyānāṃ samārabhet ||
daśamādhyāye guruśuśrūṣaṇaṃ vakṣye tadyathā śṛṇu yatnataḥ || tataḥ kurvīta śuśrūṣāṃ sadbhaktyā'haraharguroḥ || 1 || śuśrūṣāyāḥ kramaṃ cātha śṛṇuṣva caturānana || manasyavirataṃ samyaggurorākāraciṃtanam || 2 || śuśrūṣopāyatā kācit hṛcchuśrūṣetyudāhṛtā || deva kiṃ karma kartavyaṃ tadevetyuttaraṃ punaḥ || 3 || evamādipriyoktiśca sā vākśuśrūṣikā smṛtā || samīpe vāpi dūre vā svaśarīranivedanam || 4 || gamanāgamanāyāsaiḥ svabhāvānaṃdanaistathā ||
pradakṣiṇanamaskārānsamyak pādāvanejanam || 5 || payasā''jyena dadhnā vā labdhenāṃghriprapūjanam || tataḥ sūkṣmairmudgacūrṇairuṣṇena salilena ca || 6 || prakṣālya śuddhavastreṇa tadūrdhvodakamārjanam || 7 || śayyāsaṃstaraṇaṃ kṛtvā keśānsaṃmārjayennakhaiḥ || tailābhyaṃgakriyāścātha snānakarma yathā śubham || 8 || śrīkhaṃḍalepanaṃ puṣpamālikācārubaṃdhanam || śaucārthaṃ mṛjjalādīni daṃtakāṣṭhapradāpanam || 9 || pūjāsthānānulepaṃ ca gomayena savāriṇā || pūjāyai jalapuṣpāṇi tatra yogyāni vinyaset || 10 || evamādīni cānyāni gṛhakarmāṇi yāni vai || etaiḥ kṛtā ca sā sevā kāyiketyabhidhīyate || 11 || dhānyasvarṇapaśukṣetradāsīdāsāṃbarāṇi ca || paryaṃkabhūṣaṇānyatra tripādacaṣakāni ca || 12 || caṃdanānyanulepoktadravyāṇi surabhīṇi ca || keśānulepadravyāṇi kastūryādīni yāni ca || 13 || turaṃgamagajāṃdolasyaṃdanāni śubhāni ca || teṣāṃ pradānaṃ sadbhaktyā ghanaśuśrūṣikā smṛtā || 14 || dravyasāmarthyasaṃpanno yaḥ kaścicchiṣyakassadā || sarvaśuśrūṣikāṃ kuryātsa guroreva bhaktitaḥ || 15 || nyāyārjitaṃ sthitaṃ svarṇamukhyaṃ yadvyāvahārataḥ || tadeva dravyaṃ gurave dadyāddāne hi tadvaraṃ || 16 || anyāyena yadānītaṃ puruṣeṇa tu kena cit ||
na dadyādgurave tattu ratnaṃ svarṇamapi kvacit || 17 || nūtanaṃ sadṛḍhaṃ snigdhaṃ dhavalaṃ netravallabham || dadyādācchādanaṃ bhaktyā gurave sarvadā budhaḥ || 18 || (*) viśīrṇaṃ sphuṭitaṃ dagdhaṃ prāktanaṃ svadhṛtaṃ purā || (*) daṣṭaṃ kīṭādibhirvastraṃ na dadyādgurave budhaḥ || 19 || paruṣaṃ duṣkriyāyuktaṃ nīlasūtravinirmitam || paṭṭavastretaraṃ vastraṃ sujīrṇaṃ na pradāpayet || 20 || paṭṭadevāṃgacīnāni vāsāṃsyanyāni yāni ca || citrāṇi dadyānnṛpatiritaro vā dhanādhipaḥ || 21 || guroḥ priyāṇi dravyāṇi yāni kāni cidanvahaṃ || tāni bhaktyā pradeyāni śiṣyeṇa sulabhāni vai || 22 || daridraśca svayaṃ śiṣyaḥ pratisaṃvatsaraṃ yajet || vāsaḥ prāvaraṇārthāya dadyāttannetravallabham || 23 || guruṃ svagṛhamāyāṃtaṃ dṛṣṭvā bhaktiyuto nṛpaḥ || tasmai datvāśanaṃ natvā cāgre tiṣṭhedanujñayā || 24 || ācāryacaraṇadvaṃdvaprakṣālitajalaṃ sadā || yaḥ pibeddhārayedbhaktyā sarvapāpaiḥ pramucyate || 25 || caṃdanaṃ sākṣataṃ puṣpaṃ svarṇaṃ tāṃbūlamaṃbaram || pātre vidhāya gurave śiṣyo dadyātsvapāṇinā || 26 || saṃbhojayitvā svaguruṃ paścādbhuṃjīta buddhimān || guroḥ purastādyo bhuṃkte gurudrohī na saṃśayaḥ || 27 || yāni bhaktyā ca nūtnāni kaṃdamūlaphalāni ca ||
apūpānyapi cānyāni guroḥ pūrvaṃ na bhakṣayet || 28 || śiṣyena bhojanātpūrvaṃ na bhoktavyaṃ kadācana || bhojanānaṃtare'śnīyātsvaguroryaḥ sa puṇyabhāk || 29 || yo bhaktyā guruṇā bhuktaṃ pātrasthaṃ na ca muṃcati || sa bhoktā sarvaduritairmucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ || 30 || tāṃbūlamuttamaṃ tasmai tataḥ pātreṇa dāpayet || paścādiṣṭāni vastūni datvā natvā kṣamāpayet || 31 || pradattaṃ ca svaguruṇā tāṃbūlaṃ paricarvitam || śiṣyastadbhakṣayedbhaktyā śuddhāṃtaḥkaraṇo bhavet || 32 || śubhakāryeṣu sarveṣu vivāhādiṣu bhaktitaḥ || gurumabhyarcayecchiṣyo vastrahemādibhistadā || 33 || tatrāpi ca sabhāpūjāvidheḥ pūrvaṃ guruṃ yajet || tataḥ sabhāṃ yajedyogyaḥ krameṇaiva yathāśubham || 34 || sabhāṃtare guruṃ dhīmān kadācidapi nārcayet || āsanasthaṃ viśodhyāṃghrī gaṃdhapuṣpākṣatairyajet || 35 || tato'rpayetsvagurave vastrahemāṃgulīyakān || daridraścoditeṣveṣu yathāśakti tvavaṃcayan || 36 || evamevārcayecchiṣyo guruṃ labdhadhanena vā || guruyātrā devayātrā tīrthayātreti ca tridhā || 37 || āsāṃ trividhayātrāṇāṃ guruyātrā phalādhikā || guroḥ saṃdarśanārthaṃ tu bhaktyā yātrāṃ karoti yaḥ || 38 || puṇyadehī sa vijñeyaḥ samastāmaravallabhaḥ || śiṣyo gurusthitaṃ grāmaṃ na viśedvāhanena ca || 39 || varjayedgṛhasāmīpye tathā vai pādukāni ca ||
gurordidṛkṣuryaḥ śiṣyaḥ sadbhaktyā'nudinaṃ tadā || 40 || riktapāṇirna taṃ paśyedyathā rājā tathā guruḥ || phalaṃ prasūnaṃ tāṃbūlamanyatkimapi vastu ca || 41 || eṣvekaṃ gurave datvā namaskuryāttato gurum || śrīmāṃścāpi tapasvī ca śāstrataḥ kulaśīlavān || 42 || kuryāddaṃḍanamaskāraṃ nirlajjo gurusaṃnidhau || upacāreṣu sarveṣu dvāvevātyaṃtaśobhanau || 43 || priyavāṇī praṇāmaśca tau vinānye vṛthā smṛtāḥ agre dṛṣṭvā namaskṛtvā pradakṣiṇamanusmaran || 44 || pradakṣiṇaṃ ca kurvīta yathāśaktyanusārataḥ || pradakṣiṇajño yo dhīmānna tu dīrghapadaṃ nyaset || 45 || na gaccheccarito dhīmānna jalpeditaraiḥ saha || pade padāntaraṃ nyasya karau calanavarjitau || 46 || stutiṃ vācā hṛdā dhyānamevaṃ kuryātpradakṣiṇaṃ || evaṃ śiṣyaḥ śuciḥ kuryādbhaktyā saha parikramam || svaguroḥ purataḥ śiṣyau netarānkīrtayejjanān || 47 || asahyabhāṣaṇaṃ caiva na vadeditaretaram || nānṛtaṃ nāpriyaṃ vākyaṃ na guhyaṃ cāpi bhāṣayet || 48 || nāpracchannamukho brūyādguroragre kadācana || svāmibhaṭṭārakācāryadevaśrīgurunāmabhiḥ || 49 || vācyaḥ sadā guruḥ śiṣyairjātucitrānunāmabhiḥ || tvaṃ śabdaṃ na prayuṃjīta gurau śiṣyaḥ kadācana || 50 || ājñāṃ na laṃghayettasya samaṃ nopaviśedyathā || āsanaṃ vāhanaṃ vastraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ śayanaṃ tathā || 51 || na kuryādgurusādṛśyaṃ gatisiddhihitecchukaḥ || gurugehe samīpe vā na yatheṣṭāsano bhavet || 52 ||
gururdevo yataḥ sākṣāttadgṛhaṃ śivamaṃdiram || garusthitasthalāduccaiḥ sthale vā connatāsane || 53 || udagravedikāyāṃ tu śiṣyo nāsīta jātu cit || 54 || nolbaṇaṃ dhārayedveṣaṃ nālaṃkārāṃśca jātu cit || nānābhogādikānkuryānna vilāsaparo bhavet || 55 || na cottiṣṭhedviśennaiva na vṛthā kāryamācaret || dīkṣāṃ vyākhyāṃ pramattatvaṃ guroragre vivarjayet || 56 || atihāsamavaṣṭaṃbhaṃ līlāmaṃghriprasāraṇam || vinodojjvalaveṣaṃ ca paryaṃkaṃ daṃtadhāvanam || 57 || pūrvasphoṭavikāra ca pādaprakṣālanaṃ tathā || tadvākyapratikūlaṃ ca na kuryādgurusaṃnidhau || 58 || pātraṃ snānajalaṃ chāyāṃ mālyopakaraṇāni ca || bhaktihīno'pi pādābhyāṃ na spṛśennaiva laṃghayet || 59 || pādukāsanaśayyādi guruṇā yadyadīhitaṃ || namaskurvīta tatsarvaṃ pādābhyāṃ na spṛśetkvacit || 60 || na gurorāśrame kuryādupānaṭparisarpaṇam || gacchataḥ pṛṣṭhato gacchedgurośchāyāṃ na laṃghayet || 61 || nopaviṣṭe bhavedūrdhvaṃ noccāsanagate viśet || paścātpādena nirgacchennamaskṛtvā'grato guroḥ || 62 || svagurormanasābhīṣṭaṃ yattadevācaretsudhīḥ || kāryavijñāpanārthaṃ tu gurūṇāṃ dūravāsināṃ || 63 || yā trirekhāvṛtā saṃkhyā ṣaḍityabhihitā budhaiḥ ||
tāḍapatraṃ dṛḍhaṃ saumyamṛjuṃ sāgraṃ dvidhā kṛtam || 64 || mṛdulaṃ yatpraśastaṃ tanmataṃ lekhāvilekhane || karkaśaṃ kalmaṣaṃ vakraṃ hīnāgraṃ sphuṭitaṃ yugam || 65 || tālapatraṃ na tacchreṣṭhaṃ mataṃ lekhāvilekhane || visargamātrānusvārairvarṇaspaṣṭaṃ yathā bhavet || 66 || tathaiva vilikhetpatre chiṃdyādvarṇaṃ na jātucit || saṃdigdhaṃ chinnavarṇaṃ cāpraśastaṃ gūḍhabhāṣaṇam || 67 || na kadācillikhetpatre svācāryāya sadā sudhīḥ || praśastabhāṣāsaṃyuktaṃ vinayastutipūrvakam || 68 || vijñāpanīyaṃ gurave yatkāryaṃ tatsamālikhet || patraṃ cālpamiti jñeyaṃ pravilikhya prayojanam || 69 || gurorvijñāpanārthāya preṣayedaṃtikaṃ guroḥ || gacchaṃstiṣṭhansvapanjāgran yadyatkarma tamācaret || 70 || samakṣaṃ tvaparokṣaṃ vā kartavyaṃ gurvanujñayā || gurorgurustasya gurustadguroragrajā api || 71 || tadbhāryāśca namaskuryātsadā vai prītivatsalaiḥ || tathāpi svaguroḥ putraṃ paśyedgurumivāparam || 72 || ātmā vai putranāmāsīdāgamoktinidarśanāt || 73 || kadācidapi śiṣyo vai na niṃdedīśvaraṃ guruṃ || śivasya ca gurorniṃdāṃ tathā na śṛṇuyātsadā || 74 || svamātṛpitṛbhāryādibhrātṛbaṃdhusuteṣu ca || ye gurudveṣiṇastān hi natvā śiṣyaḥ parityajet || 75 ||
guruṃ niṃdati ya śiṣyo dravyaṃ harati tasya ca || karoti dveṣibhiḥ snehaṃ(?) sa cāṃḍālo na saṃśayaḥ || 76|| sanmānaṃ gurubhāṣāyāṃ guroḥ śiṣyo ya icchati || sa mahāpātakī jñeyaḥ patatyeva sa durgato || 77 || yaḥ paśyati guruṃ śiṣyaḥ sādhāraṇamanuṣyavat || tasya bhaktirdvayā brahmannevāstyatra(?) na saṃśayaḥ || 78 || yaḥ paśyati guruṃ śiṣya udāsīnamanīṣayā || sa pāpātmā mahāghore narake parivartate || 79 || dūrato yo guruṃ dṛṣṭvā codāsīnatayā vrajet || śvānayoniśataṃ gatvā bhaveccāṃḍālaveśmani || 80 || samastadevatāvāsaṃ sarvamaṃtrāspadaṃ gurum || upekṣate yaḥ pāpātmā rauravaṃ narakaṃ vrajet || 81 || hṛdi nāyaṃ mamācārya ityupekṣāṃ karoti cet || mayi bhaktirvṛthā tasya tathaiva ca samarcanam || 82 || yogyamādyaṃ guruṃ tyaktvā śiṣyaḥ kṣudrakriyānvitam || guruṃ samāśrayeddanyaṃ yaḥ sa yāti sadurgatiṃ || 83 || guroratyaṃtabhaktasya śiṣyasyeha paratra ca || na kiṃciddurlabhaṃ brahman samastaṃ sulabhaṃ sadā || 84 || atha kiṃ bahunoktena gurudevo maheśvaraḥ || pratyakṣe vā parokṣe vā guroḥ prītiṃ samācaret || 85 || guruprītikaraḥ śiṣyo yaḥ sa prītikaro mama || tasya priyakaraḥ śiṣyo mama priyakaro bhṛśaṃ || 86 ||
tasmātsarvaprayatnena guroḥ prītikaro bhavet || gurubhaktiṃ vinā tasya mayi bhaktirvṛthā bhavet || 87 || śiṣyastasmātprayatnena gurau bhaktiṃ samācaret || yaḥ kaścidgurubhaktaḥ syātsa yāti paramāṃ gatim || 88 ||
pārameśvarataṃtre (2) paṭale | mumukṣurīśvare bhaktaḥ śrīguruṃ śivamāśrayet || sarvalakṣaṇasaṃpannaṃ sarvajñaṃ sarvasaṃmatam || 63 || sadācārarataṃ śuddhaṃ śivabhaktamalolupam || yathārthavādinaṃ śāṃtaṃ dveṣāsuyādivarjitam || 64 || viditākhilaśāstrārthamiṃgitajñamanākulam || atheṃ'nāturamātmajñamakāsukamavaṃcakam(?) || 65 || vāgmivaṃ(?) śivatatvārthabodhakaṃ hṛṣṭamānasam || etādṛśaguṇopetamupeyādgurumīśvaram || 66 || riktahastena nopeyādupasarpan guruṃ śuciḥ || namaskṛtya vidhānena sāṣṭāṃgaṃ bhaktipūrvakam || 67 || kṛtāṃjalipuṭaḥ sthitvā stutvā vijñāpayettataḥ || namaste nātha bhagavan śivāya gururūpiṇe || 68 || dehi śiṣyāya me vīraśaivadīkṣāmabhīṣṭadām ||
iti pṛṣṭo'tha śiṣyeṇa yadi dātumanā guruḥ || 69 || viśodhya varṣatritayamatha taṃ dīkṣayedbudhaḥ || kuśalaṃ śrīgurorbhaktaṃ śrīguroḥ priyakāriṇam || 70 || karmaṇā manasā vācā chāyevānucaraṃ sadā || gurumaṃtrātmadaiveṣu tathaivāsanamudrayoḥ || 71 || abhedabhāvanādhīraṃ satyavādinamāstikam || prāṇārthamānavasubhirmanovākkāyakarmabhiḥ || 72 || sarvadā sarvabhāvena guruśuśrūṣaṇe ratam || apramattamudārāṃgaṃ dṛḍhacittamanāmayam || 73 || asatyavādarahitamavaṃcakamadurhṛdam || anarthalobhamarthāḍhyaṃ mṛdusaṃbhāṣaṇapriyam || 74 || ityādiguṇasaṃpannamatha taṃ dīkṣayecchivaṃ || hastamastakasaṃyogamācarecca śivaṃ smaret || 75 ||
(7) paṭale | nātmārthaṃ pācayedannaṃ nādyāccātithyanarpitaṃ || śaktyā saṃpūjayelloke jaṃgamaṃ gṛhamāgataṃ || 41 || nādyādaliṃginaścānnaṃ dṛṣṭaṃ cānnamaliṃginā || yācayedgṛhamāgatya dadyādannamaliṃgine || 42 || nodāsīnaṃ na ca dveṣaṃ na hiṃsā nāpi vaṃcanaṃ || kurvīta liṃgī yatnena vimateṣvapyaliṃgiṣu || 43 ||
pūjyapūjakabhāvādau bhojanādiṣu karmasu || vimatatvādayogyatvādevamevākhilaṃ jagat || 44 || gṛhamāyāṃtamālokya guruṃ vā'gurumeva ca || yo gṛhī bhavate namraḥ sa gururnetaraḥ kvacit || 45 || tadāgataṃ gṛhe vīkṣya pratyutthāyābhivādayet || śramāpanodanaṃ kuryādvyajanādibhirādarāt || 46 || praṇamya svāgataṃ brūyātpādaprakṣālanaṃ caret || prathamaṃ pūjayedgaṃdhapuṣpaiḥ saṃkṣālayettataḥ || 47 || aṃguṣṭhe bhāvayedrudraṃ tarjanyāṃ śaṃkaraṃ smaret || madhyamāyāṃ mahādevamanāmikyāṃ triyaṃbakaṃ || 48 || kaniṣṭhikāyāmīśānaṃ pādopari kapardinaṃ || pādādhaḥ paṃcavadanaṃ gulphayorugrabhargakau || 49 || sarvaṃ liṃgamayaṃ dhyātvā pādaṃ jaṃgamaliṃginaḥ || pibetsaṃkṣālitaṃ toyaṃ pītvā śirasi dhārayet || 50 || na pātayedadho biṃduṃ pādaprakṣālanāṃbhasāṃ || punaḥ saṃpūjayedgaṃdhapuṣpadhūpādibhiḥ kramāt || 51 || striyo vā puruṣo vāpi sarvatrātithipūjane || puṃbhiḥ puṃsāṃ striyāṃ strībhirdadyādgaṃdhādikaṃ kare || 52 || na jātibhedastatrāsti liṃgināṃ śivayogināṃ || na dṛṣṭispṛṣṭadoṣo vā sarva eva śivāḥ śive || 53 || gururliṃgaṃ jaṃgamaśca pādatīrthaṃ prasādakaṃ || dehe vibhūtirudrākṣau mama paṃcākṣarīmanuḥ || 54 ||
aṣṭāvaraṇasaṃyuktā vīramāheśvarā narāḥ || mama rūpadharā devi vicaraṃti mahītale || 55 || na tyajelliṃginā bhuktaṃ śiṣṭamucchiṣṭadhīhataḥ || na kṣālayecca tatpātraṃ na bhedaṃ tatra kārayet || 56 || yena kenāpi bhukte tu liṃginocchiṣṭapātrake || pātrābhāvaikakālādau sarve'pyaśnaṃti liṃginaḥ || 57 ||
siddhāṃtaśikhāmaṇau atha gurumāhātmyasthalam avataraṇikā(-) atha prasādaniṣṭhena jñātavyaṃ gurumāhātmyasthalaṃ nirūpayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) gururevātra sarveṣāṃ kāraṇaṃ siddhikarmaṇām || gururūpo mahādevo yataḥ sākṣādupasthitaḥ || 1 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) atra loke bhogamokṣalakṣaṇasakalasiddhikarmaṇāṃ gurureva kāraṇaṃ ṅa roradhikaṃ na guroradhikaṃ iti śivarahasyavacanāt yataḥ parameśvara eva sākṣādgururūpaḥ san upasthitaḥ tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ || 1 ||
avataraṇikā(-) nanu niṣkalaḥ śivaḥ kimarthaṃ sakalagururūpeṇa prakāśata ityatrāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) niṣkalo hi mahādevo nityajñānamahodadhiḥ || sakalo gururūpeṇa sarvānugrāhako bhavet || 2 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) nityajñānārṇavaparameśvaraḥ niṣkalo'pi niravayavo'pi gururūpeṇa sakalaḥ
san karacaraṇādiviśiṣṭaḥ san sarvānugrāhako(-)bhavet lokānugrahārthaṃ bhātītyarthaḥ || 2 ||
avataraṇikā(-)tasmādguruśivayorbhedo nāstītyāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) yaśśivassa gururjñeyo yo gurussa śivaḥ smṛtaḥ || na tayoraṃtaraṃ kuryāt jñānāvāpto mahāmatiḥ || 3 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) gurormokṣakāraṇībhūtajñānapradatvena śivābhinnatvāt anyathā jñānānudayaprasaṃgāt tadarthaṃ sūkṣmadṛk tayoraṃtaraṃ bhedaṃ na kuryādityarthaḥ || 3 ||
avataraṇikā(-) yathāhaṃ sarvalokānāṃ gururaṃbikayā saha ityāgamokteḥ śivasadṛśaṃ śrīguruṃ prākṛtaissadṛśamanuktvā pūjayedityāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) hastapādādisāmyena netaraissadṛśaṃ vadet || ācāryaṃ jñānadaṃ śuddhaṃ śivarūpatayā sthitam || 4 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) śuddhaṃ nirmalāṃtaḥkaraṇam śivajñānaprakāśakam umāmaheśvararūpeṇa sthitam śrīguruṃ hastapādādisāmyena prākṛtaissadṛśaṃ saṃtaṃ na vadet || 4 ||
avataraṇikā(-) tena kiṃ bhavatītyatrāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) ācāryasyāvamānena śreyaḥprāptirvihanyate || tasmānniśreyasaprāptyai pūjayettaṃ samāhitaḥ || 5 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) ācāryasyāvamānena prākṛtajanasamoktyā bhogamokṣalakṣaṇaśreyaḥprāptirvihanyate tasmāt niḥśreyasaprāptyai bhogamokṣāvāptyai samāhita ekāgracittaḥ san taṃ śrīguruṃ pūjayedityarthaḥ || 5 ||
avataraṇikā(-) atha yasya deve parā bhaktiryathā deve tathā gurau iti śvetāśvataraśrutyarthaṃ prakaṭayan gurumahatvasthalaṃ samāpayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) gurubhaktivihīnasya śivabhaktirna jāyate || tataḥ śive yathā bhaktistathā bhaktirgurāvapi || 6 || vyākhyānaṃ(-)spaṣṭaṃ || 6 || iti gurumahatvasthalam atha jaṃgamamāhātmyasthalam avataraṇikā(-)atha guruliṃgamahatvātsaṃvedyajaṃgamasthalaṃ prakāśayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) guruśiṣyasamārūḍhaliṃgamāhātmyasaṃpadaḥ || sarvaṃ cidrūpavijñānājjaṃgamādhikyamucyate || 1 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) ācāryaḥ pūrvarūpamaṃtevāsyuttararūpaṃ vidyāsaṃdhiḥ iti śruteḥ guruśiṣyamadhyagataśivaliṃgamahatvasaṃpadaḥ sarvaṃ viśvaprapaṃcaṃ cidrūpavijñānāt citkriyārūpatvena vijñānāt jaṃgamādhikyamucyate, guruśiṣyayoriṣṭaprāṇabhāveṣu tādātmyabhāvanayā samārūḍhaliṃgamahatvasaṃpattyā sarvaṃ viśvaṃ śivaśaktyātmakamiti vijñānameva jaṃgamādhikyamityarthaḥ || 1 ||
avataraṇikā(-) atha te keṣu jaṃgamā ityatrāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) jānaṃtyatiśayādye tu śivaṃ viśvaprakāśakam || svasvarūpatayā te tu jaṃgamā iti kīrtitāḥ || 2 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) tasya bhāsā sarvamidaṃ vibhāti iti śruteḥ ye viśvaprakāśakaṃ svakīyacitkriyāśaktibhyāṃ prapaṃcaprakāśaṃ śivaṃ atiśayena sarvāsarvaśabdārthayormāyākāryako(-)
ṭipraviṣṭatvenāsanātanatvāt etajjīvanabhūtajñatvakartṛtvayossanātanatvāt anyathā svaviṣayakajñānaśūnyatvena sphaṭikāṃdiprakāśavajjaḍatvaprasaṃgāt tayorjīveśvarasādhāraṇībhūtāsmadrūpātmatatvanijasvabhāvatvāt svayaṃ tadanatirikta iti dṛḍhataraniścayena svasvarūpatayā jānaṃti te jaṃgamā ityarthaḥ || 2 || avataraṇikā(-) atha śivayogitvena prasiddhajaṃgamamahatvaṃ paṃcabhissūtraiḥ pratipādayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) ye paśyaṃti jagajjālaṃ cidrūpaṃ śivayogataḥ || nirdhūtamalasaṃsparśāste smṛtāśśivayoginaḥ || 3 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) ye jaṃgamā devā viśvaṃ śivayogato viśvasya śivasaṃbaṃdhābhāve cidbāhyatvena saṃkalpatāpatteḥ śivasaṃbaṃdhoṃ'gīkaraṇīya eva sa ca saṃyogarūpo na bhavati tasya kriyāpūrvatvena bhinnadeśasthitayorevopapadyata iti brahmabāhyadeśābhāvena tādātmyarūpa evetyupapāditatvāt cidrūpaṃ citkriyāsvarūpamiti paśyaṃti jānaṃti te nirdhūtamalasaṃsparśā nirgatāṇavādimalasaṃbaṃdhinaḥ śivayogina iti smṛtā ityarthaḥ || 3 || ślokaḥ(-) ghorasaṃsāratimiraparidhvaṃsanakāraṇam || yeṣāmasti śivajñānaṃ te matāśśivayoginaḥ || 4 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) bhayaṃkarasaṃsārāṃdhakāranivārakaṃ śivādhikyajñānaṃ yeṣāmasti te śivayogina iti matāḥ smṛtā ityarthaḥ || 4 || avataraṇikā(-) atha te kīdṛśāḥ kathaṃ tiṣṭhaṃtītyatrāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) jitakāmā jitakrodhā mohagraṃthivibhedinaḥ || samaloṣṭāśmakanakāssādhavaśśivayoginaḥ || 5 || samāḥ śatrau ca mitre ca sākṣātkṛtaśivātmakāḥ || nispṛhā nirahaṃkārā vartaṃte śivayoginaḥ || 6 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) spaṣṭaṃ || 5 || 6 ||
avataraṇikā(-) evamuktalakṣaṇajñānasaṃpannāḥ sākṣācchivā evetyāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) durlabhaṃ hi śivajñānaṃ durlabhaṃ śivaciṃtanam || yeṣāmetaddvayaṃ cāsti te ca sākṣācchivātmakāḥ || 7 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) śivajñānaṃ śivādhikyajñānaṃ śivaciṃtanam uktayuktibhiḥ svayameva śiva iti mananaṃ ca durlabhaṃ etaddvayaṃ yeṣāmasti te sākṣācchivarūpā ityarthaḥ || 7 ||
avataraṇikā(-) atha punasteṣāṃ mahatvaṃ ślokadvayenāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) pādāgrareṇavo yatra pataṃti śivayoginām || tadeva sadanaṃ puṇyaṃ pāvanaṃ gṛhamedhinām || 8 || sarvasiddhikaraṃ puṃsāṃ darśanaṃ śivayoginām || sparśanaṃ pāpaśamanaṃ pūjanaṃ muktisādhanam || 9 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) śivayoginām jaṃgamadevānāmityarthaḥ gṛhamedhinām gṛhasthānāmityarthaḥ puṇyaṃ puṇyakṣetramityarthaḥ pāvanaṃ pavitraṃ śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭaṃ || 8 || 9 || avataraṇikā(-) athaivaṃ tādṛśaśivayogināṃ saṃparkātsarvepsitārthasiddhirityāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) mahatāṃ śivatātparyavedināmanumodinām || kiṃ vā phalaṃ na siddhyeta saṃparkācchivayoginām || 10 ||
vyākhyānaṃ(-) śivarahasyābhiprāyavedinām śivasukhānumodināṃ mahatāṃ satpuruṣāṇām jaṃgamadevānāṃ saṃparkātkiṃ vā phalaṃ na siddhyeta sarvaṃ siddhyedityarthaḥ || 10 || iti jaṃgamamahatvasthalam bhaktamāhātmyasthalam avataraṇikā(-) atha guruliṃgajaṃgamamahatvalaṃpaṭasya bhaktasya mahatvaṃ dvādaśasūtraiḥ pratipādayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) gurorliṃgasya māhātmyakathanācchivayoginām || siddhaṃ bhaktasya māhātmyaṃ tathāpyeṣa praśasyate || 1 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) guruliṃgajaṃgameṣvevaṃvidhamāhātmyajñānapūrvakaṃ bhakteḥ kriyamāṇatvena bhaktamāhātmyaṃ siddhamiti tathaivāyaṃ śāstre praśasyate utkarṣeṇa bhaṇyata ityarthaḥ || 1 || avataraṇikā(-) atha ke bhaktā ityatra yaddhi manasā dhyāyati tadvācā vadati tatkarmaṇā karoti iti śrutyarthānusāreṇa bhaktasvarūpamāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) ye bhajaṃti mahādevaṃ paramātmānamavyayam || karmaṇā manasā vācā te bhaktā iti kīrtitāḥ || 2 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) hastābhyāmarcanārūpakāyikakriyayā śivamūrtidhyānarūpamānasakriyayā stutirūpavācikakriyayā ca ye paramātmānaṃ liṃgarūpiṇaṃ mahādevaṃ bhajaṃti te bhaktā ityarthaḥ || 2 || avataraṇikā(-) śivabhakteḥ jātibhedo'sti kimityatrāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) durlabhā hi śive bhaktissaṃsārabhayatāriṇī || sā yatra vartate sākṣātsa bhaktaḥ parigīyate || 3 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) spaṣṭaṃ || 3 ||
avataraṇikā(-) tasmājjananamaraṇaparipīḍitānāṃ janānāṃ śivabhaktivyatirekeṇa kenāpi satkarmaṇā prayojanaṃ nāstītyāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) kiṃ vedaiḥ kiṃ tataḥ śāstraiḥ kiṃ yajñaiḥ kiṃ tapovrataiḥ || nāsti cecchāṃkarī bhaktirdehināṃ janmarogiṇām || 4 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) śāstraiḥ vedārthānugaiḥ śivāgamasūtrapurāṇādibhirityarthaḥ śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭaṃ || 4 ||
avataraṇikā(-) atha śivabhaktivyatirekeṇa vidhīyamānaṃ satkarma viphalaṃ viparītaphaladaṃ ceti dṛṣṭāṃtapūrvakamāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) śivabhaktivihīnasya sukṛtaṃ cāpi niṣphalaṃ || viparītaphalaṃ ca syāddakṣasyāpi mahādhvare || 5 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) syāt abhavadityarthaḥ || 5 ||
avataraṇikā(-) atha śivabhaktyā duṣkarmāpi satkarma bhavediti dṛṣṭāntapūrvakamāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) atyaṃtapāpakarmā'pi śivabhaktyā viśuddhyati || caṃḍo yathā purā bhaktyā pitṛhā'pi śivo'bhavat || 6 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) śivaḥ śivagaṇādhīśa ityarthaḥ śiṣṭaṃ spaṣṭaṃ || 6 ||
avataraṇikā(-) nanvevaṃ cet śivabhaktānāṃ puṇyapāpasaṃbaṃdho'sti vā navetyatrāha(-)
ślokaḥ(-) sukṛtaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ cāpi śivabhaktasya nāsti hi || śivabhaktivihīnānāṃ karmapāśanibaṃdhanam || 7 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) spaṣṭaṃ || 7 ||
avataraṇikā(-) tatkathamityatra dṛṣṭāṃtapūrvakaṃ sūtradvayenāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) śivāśritānāṃ jaṃtūnāṃ karmaṇā nāsti saṃgamaḥ || vājināṃ dinanāthasya kathaṃ timirajaṃ bhayam || 8 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) dinanāthasya ravervājināmaśvānāṃ yathāṃ'dhakāraprayuktabhīrnāsti tathā śivabhaktānāṃ karmaṇā puṇyapāpamayena karmaṇā saṃgamaḥ saṃbaṃdho nāstītyarthaḥ || 8 || ślokaḥ(-) niroddhuṃ na kṣamaṃ karma śivabhaktānviśṛṃkhalān || kathaṃ mattagajān ruṃdhecchṛṃkhalā bisataṃtujā || 9 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) śivadīkṣayā''ṇavādimalatrayasya nivṛttatvena viśṛṃkhalān śivabhaktān karma niroddhuṃ na kṣamaṃ na samarthaṃ tatra dṛṣṭāṃtaḥ mṛṇālataṃtunirmitā śṛṃkhalā yathā mattagajaṃ na ruṃdheta na tathetyarthaḥ || 9 ||
avataraṇikā(-) tasmācchivabhakta eva pūjya ityāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vā'pi vaiśyo vā śūdra eva vā || aṃtyajo vā śive bhaktaḥ śivavanmānya eva saḥ || 10 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) spaṣṭaṃ || 10 ||
avataraṇikā(-) nanu śūdrādīnāṃ brāhmaṇādyapekṣayā nikṛṣṭatvāt kathaṃ teṣāṃ tatsamānatvamityatrāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) śivabhaktisamāveśe kva jātiparikalpanā ||
iṃdhaneṣvagnidagdheṣu ko vā bhedaḥ prakīrtyate || 11 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) spaṣṭam || 11 ||
avataraṇikā(-) tasmācchivabhaktā eva gaṇeśvarā ityuktvā bhaktamāhātmyaṃ samāpayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) śuddhā niyamasaṃyuktāḥ śivārpitaphalāgamāḥ || arcayaṃti śivaṃ loke vijñeyāste gaṇeśvarāḥ || 12 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) ye śuddhāḥ dīkṣayā paripūtaḥ niyamasaṃpannāḥ śivavratinaḥ śivārpitaphalāgamāḥ tadarpitapuṇyapāpaphalāgamāḥ saṃtaḥ loke śivaliṃgamarcayaṃti te ṅāśivasya śivopāstiḥ ṅārudro rudramarcayet ityādivacanaiḥ gaṇeśvarā iti rudrā iti vijñeyā ityarthaḥ || 12 ||
iti bhaktamāhātmyasthalam avataraṇikā(-) gurusvarūpaṃ viśadayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) guṇātītaṃ gukāraṃ ca rūpātītaṃ rukārakam || guṇātītamarūpaṃ ca yo dadyātsa guruḥ smṛtaḥ || 8 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) gukāraṃ prākṛtaguṇātītaṃ rukāraṃ aśuddhamāyārūpātītaṃ guṇātītamarūpaṃ ca maṃḍalatrayātmakaguṇatrayaṃ jyotirmayabaiṃdavakalāśūnyacinmayavastu yaḥ dadāti upadiśati saḥ guruḥ smṛtaḥ gururiti smṛta ityarthaḥ || 8 ||
avataraṇikā(-) athaitatprasaṃgādācāryasvarūpaṃ ca viśadayati(-) śloka(-) ācinoti ca śāstrārthānācāre sthāpayatyalam ||
svayamācarate yasmādācāryastena cocyate || 9 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) śāstrārthān vīraśaivaśāstrarahasyārthān prakaṭīkṛtya kathayati ācāre vīraśaivācāre śiṣyān alaṃ ādhikyena sthāpayati niyamayati svayaṃ ca vīraśaivācāre ācarate tena hi tena kāraṇena ācāryo vaktā kuśalo'sya labdha iti kaṭhavallīśrutyanusāreṇācārya ityucyata ityarthaḥ || 9 ||
avataraṇikā(-) atha deśikaśabdanirvacanaṃ ca kṛtvā śivaliṃgaikya eva jagadgururiti sūtradvayenoktadīkṣāgurusthalaṃ samāpayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) ṣaḍadhvātītayogena yatate yastu deśikaḥ || māyābdhitāraṇopāyaheturviśvaguruḥ śivaḥ || 10 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) jñānānmuktiṃ diśati yassa deśika iti smṛtaḥ iti kāmikavākyaprasiddho yo deśikaḥ ṣaḍadhvātītayogena adhvanāmadhvapate śreṣṭhasyādhvanaḥ pāramaya iti śrutiprasiddhavarṇapadādiṣaḍadhvātītayogena yatate udyogavānāste sa śivaḥ śivaliṃgaikyaḥ māyābdhitāraṇopāyahetubhūtajagadgururityarthaḥ || 10 ||
avataraṇikā(-) atha kathamayaṃ jagadgururityāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) akhaṃḍaṃ yena caitanyaṃ vyajyate sarvavastuṣu || ātmayogaprabhāvena sa gururviśvabhāsakaḥ || 11 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) sarvavastuṣu nīlapītādisakalavastuṣu ātmayogaprabhāvena svānubhavabalāt akhaṃḍaṃ saccidānaṃdātmakaṃ caitanyaṃ yena vyajyate nīlapītādipratiniyatapadārthāvabhāsanakāle'pyahamityakhaṃḍacaitanyamanuvar tata eva anyathā tadvedyadarśanaṃ na syāditi sphuṭīkriyate sa guruḥ viśvabhāsakaḥ viśvaprakāśaka ityarthaḥ || 11 || || iti dīkṣāgurusthalam ||
|| atha śikṣāgurusthalam || avataraṇikā(-) atha bodhyabodhakabhāvena jñānadvāreṇa śāsyate || śiṣyo hi yena guruṇā sa śikṣāgururucyate iti vātulottaravacanānusāreṇa śikṣāgurusthalaṃ nirūpayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) dīkṣāgururasau śikṣāhetuḥ śiṣyasya bodhakaḥ || praśnottarapravaktā ca śikṣāgururitīryate || 1 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) asau dīkṣāguruḥ śiṣyasya bodhakaḥ san praśnottarapravaktā śiṣyakṛtapraśnasyottaraṃ datvā śikṣāhetuśca śikṣākāraṇaḥ san śikṣāgururiti kathyata ityarthaḥ || 1 ||
avataraṇikā(-) athāmumevārthaṃ sphuṭayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) bodhako'yaṃ samākhyāto bodhyametaditi sphuṭam || śiṣye niyujyate yena sa śikṣāgururucyate || 2 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) ayaṃ śivasiddhāṃtabodhakaḥ paratatvaprakāśaka ityarthaḥ ṅa so'sti pratyayo loke yaḥ śabdānugamādṛte | iti vaiyākaraṇokteḥ sphuṭaṃ deśikopadeśasphuṭībhūtaṃ etat śivayogajñānaṃ bodhyaṃ iti yena guruṇā śiṣyaḥ samākhyātaḥ bodhakaḥ san niyujyate niyamyate sa śikṣāgururityucyata ityarthaḥ || 2 || avataraṇikā(-) atha ācāryaḥ pūrvarūpaṃ aṃtevāsyuttararūpaṃ vidyā saṃdhiḥ ācāryoṃ'tevāsinamāśāsti iti śrutyanusāreṇa dvaividhyena tatsvarūpaṃ varṇayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) saṃsāratimironmāthiśaraccaṃdramarīcayaḥ || vāco yasya pravartaṃte tamācāryaṃ pracakṣate || 3 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) yasya vācaḥ upadeśavākyāni saṃsāratimiravināśane śaraccaṃdramarīcaya
iva pravartaṃte taṃ ācāryaṃ saṃtaṃ pracakṣate kathayaṃti || 3 || ślokaḥ(-) dadāti yaḥ patijñānaṃ jaganmāyānivartakam || advaitavāsanopāyaṃ tamācāryavaraṃ viduḥ || 4 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) yo jaganmāyānivartakam prāpaṃcikabhedabhrāṃtinivartakam patijñānaṃ patiṃ viśvasyātmeśvaraṃ śāśvatam śivamacyutam iti nārāyaṇopaniṣatprasiddhasvātmābhinnaśivajñānam dadāti prakāśayati taṃ ācāryavaraṃ ācāryaśreṣṭaṃ saṃtaṃ viduḥ jānaṃtītyarthaḥ || 4 || avataraṇikā(-) atha śivādvaitajñānasaṃpannaḥ san śiṣyasaṃdehavāraka eva guruśreṣṭha iti sūtradvayenāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) pūrvapakṣaṃ samādāya jagadbhedavikalpanam || advaitakṛtasiddhāṃto gurureṣa guṇādhikaḥ || 5 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) jagadbhedavikalpanaṃ prāpaṃcikabhedadvaividhyaviśiṣṭaṃ pūrvapakṣaṃ samādāya aṃgīkṛtya advaitakṛtasiddhāṃtavāneṣa guruḥ śikṣāgurureva guṇādhikaḥ śreṣṭha ityarthaḥ || 5 ||
ślokaḥ(-) saṃdehavanasaṃdohasamucchedakuṭhārikā || yatsūktidhārā vimalā sa gurūṇāṃ śikhāmaṇiḥ || 6 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) vimalā nirmalā yatsūktidhārā yasya gurorupadeśavākyadhārā saṃdehavanasaṃdohasamucchedakuṭhārikā saṃśayāraṇyasamucchedaparaśuḥ saḥ gurūṇāṃ śikhāmaṇiḥ śreṣṭha ityarthaḥ || 6 ||
avataraṇikā(-) athe (*)(?) marthameva viśeṣayati sūtradvayena(-) ślokaḥ(-) yatsūktidarpaṇābhoge nirmale dṛśyate sadā ||
mokṣaśrīrbiṃbarūpeṇa sa gururbhavatārakaḥ || 7 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) nirmale yasyopadeśoktidarpaṇamaṃḍale mokṣalakṣmīḥ biṃbarūpeṇa pratibiṃbarūpeṇetyarthaḥ dṛśyate prakāśate sa guruḥ bhavatārakaḥ saṃsārārṇavatāraka ityarthaḥ || 7 ||
avataraṇikā(-) atha prakārāṃtareṇāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) śiṣyāṇāṃ hṛdayālekhyaṃ pradyotayati yaḥ svayam || jñānadīpikayā'nena guruṇā kaḥ samo bhavet || 8 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) yaḥ śrīguruḥ śiṣyāṇāṃ hṛdayālekhyaṃ hṛtkamalasthanijarūpacitraṃ jñānadīpikayā jñānadīpena pradyotayati prakāśayati anena guruṇā śikṣāguruṇā kaḥ samo bhavet na ko'pi sama ityarthaḥ || 8 || avataraṇikā(-) athaitādṛśagururasti vetyatrāsti durlabha ityuktvā śikṣāgurusthalaṃ samāpayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) paramādvaitavijñānaparamauṣadhidānataḥ || saṃsāraroganirmāthī deśikaḥ kena labhyate || 9 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) śivakāruṇyarahitena kenāpi na labhyata ityarthaḥ || 9 || iti śikṣāgurusthalam ||
|| atha jñānagurusthalam || avataraṇikā(-) atha śhivarūpānusaṃdhāyi jñānaṃ yenopadiśyate || mumukṣormokṣasiddhyarthaṃ sa jñānagururucyate iti vātulottaravacanānusāreṇa jñānagurusthalaṃ nirūpayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) upadeṣṭopadeśānāṃ saṃśayacchedakārakaḥ || samyagjñānapradassākṣādeṣa jñānaguruḥ smṛtaḥ || 1 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) upadeśānāṃ rahasyārthānāṃ upadeṣṭā upadeśakṛt saṃśayacchedakārakaḥ śiṣya(-)
saṃdehavāraka eṣaḥ śikṣāgurureva samyak sākṣāt jñānapradaḥ pratyakṣībhūtaśivajñānapradaḥ san jñānagururiti smṛta ityarthaḥ || 1 ||
avataraṇikā(-) nanu śivajñānaṃ kīdṛśaṃ tatkathaṃ pratyakṣīkarotītyatrāha(-) ślokaḥ(-) nirastaviśvasaṃbhedanirvikāraṃ cidaṃbaram || sākṣātkaroti yo yuktyā sa jñānagururucyate || 2 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) nirastaviśvasaṃbhedaṃ na kiṃcidavediṣamiti śūnyapratītibalāt nirākṛtaviśvabhedaṃ vikārarahitaṃ cidākāśaṃ cidvyoma yuktyā sphuṭatarabhāsamānanīlasukhādipramātranveṣaṇadvārā pāramārthikapramātṛlābha ihopadiśyata iti śivādvaitaśāstroktasvānubhavayuktyā yaḥ pratyakṣīkaroti sa jñānagururityarthaḥ || 2 ||
avataraṇikā(-) atha śivajñānaṃ prastauti sūtradvayena(-) ślokaḥ(-) kalaṃkavānasau caṃdraḥ kṣayavṛddhipariplutaḥ || niṣkalaṃkasthito jñānacaṃdramā nirvikāravān || 3 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) kṣayavṛddhipariplutaḥ kṣayavṛddhipīḍyamānaḥ asau caṃdraḥ kalaṃkavān nirvikāravān vikārarahitaḥ jñānacaṃdramāḥ ciccaṃdraḥ niṣkalaṃkasthitaḥ kalaṃkarahitaḥ san tiṣṭhatītyarthaḥ || 3 || ślokaḥ(-) pārśvasthatimiraṃ haṃti pradīpo maṇinirmitaḥ || sarvagāmi tamo haṃti bodhadīpo niraṃkuśaḥ || 4 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) maṇinirmitaḥ ratnanirmitaḥ dīpaḥ pārśvasthāṃdhakāraṃ nivārayati niraṃkuśaḥ anargalaḥ bodhadīpaḥ citpradīpaḥ sarvagāmi tamaḥ sarvatra vidyamānaṃ tamaḥ nivārayatītyarthaḥ || 4 ||
avataraṇikā(-) atha śivajñānopadeśatatparaṃ śrīguruṃ sūtradvayenaprastauti(-) ślokaḥ(-) sarvārthasādhakajñānaviśeṣādeśatatparaḥ || jñānācāryassamastānāmanugrahakaraḥ śivaḥ || 5 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) bhogamokṣalakṣaṇasarvaprayojanasādhakaśivajñānaviśeṣopadeśāsaktaḥ jñānagurureva samastānāṃ mumukṣūṇāṃ anugrahakaraḥ sākṣācchiva ityarthaḥ || 5 || ślokaḥ(-) kaṭākṣacaṃdramā yasya jñānasāgaravardhanaḥ || saṃsāratimiracchedī sa gururjñānapāragaḥ || 6 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) yasyācāryasya kaṭākṣacaṃdramāḥ śivajñānodadhivardhanaḥ saṃsāratimiracchedī sa guruḥ śrīguruḥ jñānapāragaḥ parāparajñānapāraṃgata ityarthaḥ || 6 ||
avataraṇikā(-) atha tameva guruṃ bhānutvena varṇayan tato'pyādhikyaṃ pratipādayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) bahistimiravicchettā bhānureṣa prakīrtitaḥ || bahiraṃtastamaśchedī vibhurdeśikabhāskaraḥ || 7 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) eṣa bhānuḥ bahistimiravicchettā bāhyāṃdhakāranivārakaḥ vibhuḥ cidvyāpakaḥ deśikabhāskaraḥ jñānācāryasūryaḥ bahiraṃtastamaśchedī nāyaṃ śiva iti viṣayagatamajñānaṃ nāhaṃ śiva ityaṃtargatajñānaṃ bhinattīti prakīrtitaḥ || 7 ||
avataraṇikā(-) atha śivavedakaṃ śivajñānaṃ sūcayitvā jñānagurusthalaṃ sūtradvayena samāpayati(-) ślokaḥ(-) kaṭākṣaleśamātreṇa vinā dhyānādikalpanam || śivatvaṃ bhāvayedyatra sa vedaḥ śāṃbhavo mataḥ || 8 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) dhyānadhāraṇādisaṃkalpaṃ vinā śrīguroḥ kṛpāpāṃgadarśanamātreṇa śivatvaṃ bhāvayet sphuṭaṃ bhavet sa vedaḥ śāṃbhava iti mataḥ saṃmata ityarthaḥ || 8 || ślokaḥ(-) śivavedakare jñāne datte yena sunirmale || jīvanmukto bhavecchiṣyassa gururjñānasāgaraḥ || 9 || vyākhyānaṃ(-) yena śrīguruṇā śivavedakare svātmaśivatāsphuṭīkaraṇapravīṇe nirmale śivajñāne datte sati śiṣyo jīvannapi muktaḥ syāt sa guruḥ śivajñānasāgara ityarthaḥ || 9 ||
pārameśvarāgame (5) paṭale | yo vijānāti girije sa māmeva na saṃśayaḥ || arcayejjaṃgamaṃ dhanyaḥ saṃdhyāyāṃ gṛhamāgataṃ || 87 || labdhamātreṇa ca gṛhe śiṣṭena svātmajīvanāt || yo'rcayejjaṃgamānbhaktyā māmevārcitavān hi saḥ || 88 || sākṣānmadrūpamīśāni śayanāsanabhojanaiḥ || anāthaṃ rogiṇaṃ dīnaṃ mūkaṃ badhirameva ca || 89 || paṃguṃ muṃḍaṃ durācāraṃ nāvamanyeta liṃginaṃ || na kāryaḥ kalaho devi anyo'nyaṃ śivayogibhiḥ || 90 || na paiśunyaṃ na mātsaryaṃ na drohaṃ nāpi pīḍanaṃ ||
na spṛśedāyudhaṃ kvāpi prāṇaiḥ kaṃṭhagatairapi || 91 ||
(6) paṭale | jaṃgamaṃ pūjayedyastu sākṣānmadrūpamīśvaram || sa māṃ pūjitavāneva so'haṃ devi na saṃśayaḥ || 11 || tasmādyo bhaktimān śakto jaṃgameṣu mahātmasu || taddhi bhaktasthalaṃ viddhi mama cātipriyaṃ śive || 12 || yo gurūktena mārgeṇa liṃgapūjārataḥ sadā || jaṃgamānarcayecchaktyā sa hi māheśvaraḥ smṛtaḥ || 13 || trikālamarcayelliṃgaṃ mama bhakteṣu bhaktimān || svamatācāranirataḥ sa vai māheśvaraḥ priye || 14 || jalatatvamidaṃ devi tanuranyatamā mama || tasyādhidevatā cāhaṃ so'haṃ devi na saṃśayaḥ || 15 || ya uktalakṣaṇastu syādācāre jaṃgamārcane || sthalaṃ māheśvaraṃ viddhi mama cātipriyaṃ śive || 16 || yo'narpitaṃ maheśāni nārcayitvāpi jaṃgamān || nāśnāti na tyajenmahyamarpitaṃ kṛcchrago'pi vā || 17 || so'yaṃ prasādī kathitaḥ so'hameva na saṃśayaḥ || tatprasādisthalaṃ viddhi mama cātipriyaṃ śive || 18 ||
